summary.zh-TW: 從損益表上的每股盈餘出發，加上市場的股價，算出本益比，再練習判讀倍數高低的意義與它的限制。本章是會計觀念練習，不是投資建議。
summary.en: Start from earnings per share on the income statement, add the market share price to arrive at the price-to-earnings ratio, then practise reading what a high or low multiple means and where it breaks down. This chapter is an accounting concept exercise, not investment advice.
